meta.title: SUN — a universal signed language with Scripture, for Deaf groups with nothing
meta.source: sun.bible, fetched and verified by content
meta.doctrine: Evangelical Bible-translation organisation publishing the 66-book canon. Checked deliberately: the Deaf are the most heavily targeted group in this dataset by publishers this build excludes.
meta.what_it_is: Symbols of Universal Notation — a signed language built to be learnable across sign languages, with Scripture translated into it. A BRIDGE, exactly like a spoken bridge language: a real way in that has to be learned, and no substitute for Scripture in a group's own sign language.
meta.why_no_per_language_urls: sun.bible answers 200 for /sun/<anything> and /resource/<anything>. Only URLs verified by their content are shipped; a constructed per-language URL would look valid and could be empty.
